summary: Dyne Therapeutics filed a Form 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 furnishing a press release and presentation with additional one-year clinical data from the multiple ascending dose portion of its Phase 1/2 ACHIEVE trial of zeleciment basivarsen (DYNE-101) in myotonic dystrophy type 1, plus baseline video hand-opening time for the registrational expansion cohort. No corporate transaction, securityholder action, or strategic event is disclosed; the filing is a routine Regulation FD and Other Events disclosure of clinical results, with no deal terms, advisors, or board recommendation stated.
